description: This file defines the ErrorResponse class, which implements JsonSerializable and provides a structured way to represent error responses in a JSON API. It includes properties for status, title, detail, and exception information, with methods to set these properties and serialize the error response. Additionally, it handles detailed exception information in debug mode.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: A class that encapsulates error response details for JSON API responses, supporting debug mode detailed exception outputs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the error response, optionally with debug mode setting.

methods.name: setException
methods.description: Associates an exception object with the error response.

methods.name: getExceptionArray
methods.description: Returns an array representation of the associated exception, including nested previous exceptions.

methods.name: exceptionToArray
methods.description: Static method that converts an Exception object into an array with detailed info, including previous exceptions.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the error response into an array suitable for JSON encoding, including exception details in debug mode.
